Done. `RETRY_COUNT` now reads from `process.env.RETRY_COUNT` and defaults to 3. The `retries()` function remains the way the rest of code accesses it — no changes needed elsewhere.

To use it:
```bash
RETRY_COUNT=5 node your-app.js  # Use 5 retries
node your-app.js                # Defaults to 3 retries
```
